3140000 ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT between CORNELLUNIVERSITY and CORNELLREALPROPERTYSERVICES,INC. New York County BLOCK:1483 ·LOT:9 RECORD AND RETURN: Rosenberg & Estis, P.C. 733ThirdAvenue New York, NY 10017 Attn: Lisa R Radetsky, Esq.

EXECUTIONCOPY THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this “Agreement"), made as of January Q_, 2015, by and between CORNELL UNIVERSITY, a corporation formed by a special act of the legislature of the State of New York on April 27, 1865, having an office at 1300 York Avenue, New York, New York 10065 ("Owner"), and CORNELL REAL PROPERTY SERVICES, INC., a New York not-for profit corporation, having an office at c/o Office of the University Counsel, Cornell University, 300 CCC Building, Garden Avenue, Ithaca,NewYork 14853("Lessee"). RECITALS WHEREAS: A. Owner is the owner of fee title to a certain parcel of land designated on the Tax Map of the City of New York,County of New York as Tax Lot 9 in Block 1483, and more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part of hereof (the “Land"). B. The Land constitutes a single “zoning lot," as such term is defined in Section 12- 10 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York effective December 15, 1961 (as amended from time to time, the “Zoning Resolution"). C.  The Land is developed with certain improvements, including the buildings known as and by the street addresses 515 East 71st Street (the “S Building") and 516 East 72nd Street (the S Building and the 516 East 72nd Street building collectively, the “Building"). D.  The Building contains less than the maximum Floor Area Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) appurtenant to the Land pursuant to the “floor area ratio,”" as such term is defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution, applicable to the Land as of the date hereof. E.There are Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant to the Land which are in excess of the Floor Area Development Rights utilized by the Building as of the date hereof and are available for use or transfer pursuant to the Zoning Resolution. F. Owner and Lessee are parties to that certain Agreement of Lease dated as of July 1, 2014 (as amended from time to time, the “Lease"), pursuant to which Lessee leased the Land and Building from Owner, a memorandum of which Lease has been recorded in the land records; notwithstanding the recording of the memorandum of the Lease prior hereto, the Lease is subject andsubordinatetothisAgreement. G. Pursuant to the Lease, Lessee will submit the leasehold estate in the Land and Building granted to Lessee pursuant to the Lease to the provisions of Section 339 of the New York Real Property Law (the “"Condominium Act") to create a condominium (the 'Condominium") where each condominium unit is a separate tax lot.
